cards.title: 01-分词过程
cards.prompt:
Single-page hand-drawn educational infographic in a clean presentation style. Warm cream paper background, black hand-drawn lines with slight wobble, soft pastel color blocks. Diagram-style visuals ONLY — no realistic or photographic images.

PALETTE: macaron — soft pastel blocks on warm cream
COLORS: Warm Cream background (#F5F0E8); Black (#1A1A1A) for ALL lines, text, arrows, and doodles; section fills in Light Blue (#A8D8EA), Mint Green (#B5E5CF), Lavender (#D5C6E0), Peach (#FFD5C2); Coral Red (#E8655A) sparingly for one or two emphasis points only.

LAYOUT (top → bottom):
- TOP: Bold hand-lettered title "文本 → Token ID", oversized, slightly wobbly, with a small scissors doodle underneath.
- MIDDLE: A horizontal strip showing the input sentence "今天天气真好，适合出去玩" being sliced into 6 colored token blocks, each block is a rounded rectangle with the token text inside and its ID number below:
  - "今天" (ID 5237) — Light Blue fill
  - "天气" (ID 16652) — Mint Green fill
  - "真好" (ID 67261) — Lavender fill
  - "，" (ID 303) — Peach fill
  - "适合" (ID 10447) — Light Blue fill
  - "出去玩" (ID 122377) — Mint Green fill
  Small hand-drawn scissors or cut-line marks between each block.
  Below the token blocks, a small annotation: "词表大小: 129,280 个 token"
- BOTTOM: One short hand-lettered takeaway: "分词器把文本切成 token，每个 token 拿到一个整数编号"

ELEMENTS: Rounded token blocks with pastel fills, hand-drawn scissors/cut marks, ID labels below each block, small doodle decorations (stars, underlines). Generous white space between sections.

STYLE: Minimal, well-organized, airy. Color fills don't completely fill outlines (slight "hand-painted" overshoot). ALL text hand-lettered — no computer fonts. Short labels and keywords only, never long paragraphs. Generous white space.

Color values (#hex) and color names are rendering guidance only — do NOT display color names, hex codes, or palette labels as visible text in the image.

Clean composition with generous white space. Simple or no background. Main elements centered or positioned by content needs.

All text in the image MUST be in Chinese.
